Table edit visual empowers you to directly edit dimensional tables within Power BI, enhancing the efficiency of business performance planning. This feature is designed to facilitate master data management and streamline workflows, making financial planning more agile and effective. Key features: Easily create budget planning or forecasting scenarios and versions, facilitating an agile planning process. Effortlessly create, update, or delete data in dimensional tables with bulk editing capabilities, saving time and reducing effort. Seamlessly adapt to your organizational workflows such as designing and implementing standardized approval workflows. Important Business performance planning visuals require a Dynamics 365 Finance license. Learn more Édition de table : planification des performances commerciales de Dynamics 365 Finance Simplifiez la gestion des données avec le visuel d’édition de table. Le visuel d’édition de table vous permet de modifier directement les tables dimensionnelles dans Power BI, améliorant ainsi l’efficacité de la planification des performances commerciales. Cette fonctionnalité est conçue pour faciliter la gestion des données de base et rationaliser les flux de travail, rendant la planification financière plus agile et efficace.…
